title: Robust Julia Setup for R Packages
text: Julia setup R packages wrap Julia engine. juliaready collects patterns otherwise learn hard way building R package calls Julia: Julia binary use several installed; Julia version pinned project needs; install Julia packages without leaving depot unstable state; load .jl bridge files reliably; manage lazy initialisation; recover Julia process goes away; keep Julia object alive R release safely. small opinionated. consuming package replaces 100 lines brittle boilerplate 5.

title: Robust Julia Setup for R Packages
text: juliaready runs Julia JuliaConnectoR, separate process R. main alternative, JuliaCall, embeds Julia R process. work simple cases. JuliaCall, though, R Julia share memory, threads, signal handlers dynamic linker. problem crashes . seen segfaults LD_LIBRARY_PATH poisoning subprocess Julia, Pkg.activate(<path>) followed Pkg.instantiate() -process JuliaCall, accessing fields NamedTuple results via julia_eval. JuliaConnectoR, Julia segfault closes TCP socket R keeps running. crashed simulation can recovered. --process Julia also leaves much shorter list things must avoid. JuliaCall larger ecosystem frequent commits, activity platform-compatibility work. -process linking problems fixed without changing architecture. Consumer packages call juliaready::eval_julia(), call_julia() import_julia() never touch JuliaConnectoR directly. choice backend stays one place.
